intro.label: TWO MARKS · TWO MEANINGS
intro.labelZh: 两码两义 · 扫哪一枚，决定你遇见什么

spine:unclaimed.note: Anyone can meet the book. The spine mark is the shop window, not the door.
spine:unclaimed.noteZh: 任何人都能遇见这本书。脊码是橱窗，不是家门。

spine:claimed.statusZh: 已认领 · 仍对所有人开放
spine:claimed.note: Claiming does not privatise the spine mark. The preview layer stays open to the next reader.
spine:claimed.noteZh: 认领不会把脊码变成私有码；试读层对下一位读者依然开放。

pageEdge:unclaimed.statusZh: 未认领 · 回落试读层
pageEdge:unclaimed.note: Anyone may scan it, but before purchase it falls back to the preview layer. The soul is not yours yet.
pageEdge:unclaimed.noteZh: 谁都能扫，但购前只回落到试读层——云魂尚未归你。

pageEdge:claimed.note: The first page-edge scan after purchase is the claim. The full cloud soul now answers.
pageEdge:claimed.noteZh: 购后第一次页边扫码即认领；完整云魂从此只应答你。

dataNotes: Scanning a page-edge mark before purchase must never unlock the full cloud soul (worldview D1).
The preview layer carries no reader data (worldview D4).
The spine mark stays public after claiming; only the page-edge mark changes meaning.
